newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul court to protect assets of Hanbo affiliates.
newsitem.headline: Seoul court to protect assets of Hanbo affiliates.

text.p: A South Korean court has decided to protect assets of Sang-A Pharmaceutical Co Ltd and Hanbo Energy Co, both affiliates of insolvent Hanbo Steel Co, a court official said on Wednesday.
Sang-A and Hanbo Energy are awaiting a ruling on their requests for court receivership filed late January after Hanbo Steel, the flagship of Hanbo Group, made a similar request.

A Seoul court has already decided to freeze assets of Hanbo Steel, which racked up about five trillion won in loans from 61 banks and financial institutions before being declared insolvent on January 23.
